news_cards.title: Prime Minister Narendra Modi Pays Tribute to Quit India Movement Participants
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi paid tribute to the brave participants of the Quit India Movement, remembering their courage and determination in India's freedom struggle.
The Quit India Movement's leadership by Mahatma Gandhi infused new energy into the freedom struggle, reflecting the unwavering resolve of the people of India to break free from colonial rule.

news_cards.title: NBA Disburses Rs. 3.79 Crore under Access and Benefit Sharing Mechanism
bullets: The National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) disbursed around Rs. 3.79 crore to 33 State Biodiversity Boards (SBBs) and Union Territory Biodiversity Councils (UTBCs), the ICAR-National Bureau of Plant Genetic Resources (NBPGR), and the Haryana State Biodiversity Board.

The release covers a diverse range of India's agrobiodiversity, including tomato, chilli, brinjal, cauliflower, watermelon, bitter gourd, bottle gourd, okra, mustard seed varieties, and deep-frozen Sahiwal cattle semen.

news_cards.title: Centralised Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System (CPGRAMS)
bullets: The Centralised Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System (CPGRAMS) has transformed public grievance redressal in India through digital innovation, institutional reforms, and citizen-centric service delivery.
CPGRAMS enables timely grievance resolution, promotes accountability, and strengthens transparent governance while ensuring that every citizen's voice is heard and addressed.

news_cards.title: Jharkhand Government to Hold Fresh Talks with Student Representatives
bullets: The Jharkhand government will hold fresh talks with student representatives on Sunday, August 9, 2026, after the first five rounds of talks failed to break the deadlock.
The talks are aimed at resolving the issue of alleged recruitment exam irregularities and addressing the demands of the student leaders.

news_cards.title: School Headmaster Shot Dead in West Bengal
bullets: A school headmaster was shot dead by unidentified men on a motorcycle in Uttar Dinajpur district of West Bengal on Saturday, August 8, 2026.
The incident has left the locality in a state of shock, and the police are investigating the matter.
